name: mutedeck
title: MuteDeck
description: Control your meetings from Raycast: toggle mute, camera, screen share and recording via MuteDeck, with a live Meeting Deck grid.
author: chad_walters

commands.name: show-status
commands.title: Meeting Deck
commands.subtitle: MuteDeck
commands.description: A live Stream Deck-style grid of your meeting controls.

commands.name: toggle-video
commands.title: Toggle Camera
commands.subtitle: MuteDeck
commands.description: Turn your camera on or off.

commands.name: toggle-share
commands.title: Toggle Screen Share
commands.subtitle: MuteDeck
commands.description: Start or stop sharing your screen.

commands.name: toggle-record
commands.title: Toggle Recording
commands.subtitle: MuteDeck
commands.description: Start or stop the meeting recording.

preferences.name: apiEndpoint
preferences.title: API Endpoint
preferences.description: Base URL of the MuteDeck HTTP API.

preferences.name: wsEndpoint
preferences.title: WebSocket Endpoint
preferences.description: MuteDeck WebSocket URL, used for Bring to Front.

preferences.name: confirmMuteInPresentation
preferences.title: Confirm Mute While Presenting
preferences.description: Ask before toggling the microphone while sharing or recording.
preferences.label: Show confirmation dialog

preferences.name: confirmVideoInPresentation
preferences.title: Confirm Video While Presenting
preferences.description: Ask before toggling the camera while sharing or recording.
preferences.label: Show confirmation dialog

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
